AppError.title: Something went wrong
AppError.description: An unexpected error occurred. Check your connection and try again.
AppError.contactPrefix: If this keeps happening, contact us at

AccountFingerprint.title: Account fingerprint
AccountFingerprint.description: Compare this fingerprint with Android and the bridge to confirm they are connected to the same encrypted account. It is not a recovery secret.
AccountFingerprint.unavailable: Fingerprint unavailable. Make sure sync has finished initializing, then try again.

RestoreDiagnostics.title: Restore diagnostics
RestoreDiagnostics.description: Copy a privacy-safe restore report when support asks for sync diagnostics. This action appears only when restore diagnostics are available in debug-enabled preview or local sessions.

Notes.title: Notes
Notes.offlineMessage: You are offline. Encrypted changes will sync when reconnected.
Notes.emptyDescription: Write privately in Markdown. Add a note to get started.
Notes.noVisibleNotesDescription: Show a notebook to see its notes here.
Notes.selectNote: Select a note to edit, or create a new one.
Notes.deleteConfirmMessage: "{title}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
Notes.noSearchResultsDescription: Search looks at titles and text of the notes shown here, on this device only.
Notes.noNotesInNotebookDescription: New notes go here while this notebook is selected.
Notes.deleteNotebookMessage: {count, plural, =0 {"{name}" is empty and will be permanently deleted.} one {"{name}" and the # note in it will be permanently deleted.} other {"{name}" and the # notes in it will be permanently deleted.}} This cannot be undone.
